title: How Charging Your Phone Outside the Bedroom Gives God the First Word
caption:
Your phone gets the first word every morning.

Whatever you take in first sets the tone for the day. For most of us that's a feed, not the Word. One small change fixes the order: charge the phone outside the bedroom, buy a ten-dollar alarm clock, and put your Bible where the phone used to sleep (Psalm 5:3).

Try it tonight.

Save this and do it before you scroll.
